csv_project_name: Design for Logan New Utilities Operation Center Building
csv_scope_of_work: Pinellas COUNTY Utilities (COUNTY) owns and operates Logan Laboratory and Pumping Station (Logan Lab). The COUNTY desires to expand its daily operations and enhance its emergency preparedness infrastructure at Logan Lab with a new multi-functional building on site. The Logan UOC Building project (the PROJECT) is to design a new one-story building, approximately 13,000 square feet (SF), at 1620 Ridge Road S. Largo, Florida. This new building will house COUNTY administration offices, for approximately 30 daily employees and serve as an Emergency Operations Center (EOC) during storm events. As an EOC, this facility will be designed to safely accommodate up to 310 occupants during a storm event while still maintaining daily COUNTY operations. This scope of work was developed from a conceptual design for the COUNTY. This project has been submitted for Hazard Mitigation Grant Program (HMGP) funding for the construction phase of the project. The County has chosen to construct this project under a Construction Management at Risk Agreement and will execute an agreement simultaneously. Survey and SUE services will be performed and provided once completed.
